sources.snippet: Overview PaddleOCR-VL-1.6-GGUF is a document parsing vision-language model maintained by PaddlePaddle that achieves 96.33% state-of-the-art accuracy on OmniDocBench v1.6. This 0.9B parameter model processes document images and extracts structured text with spatial layout information, designed for compact deployment through GGUF quantization. sources.snippet: Introduction We introduce PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, an upgraded compact document parsing model built upon PaddleOCR-VL-1.5. PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 introduces a region-aware data optimization framework that identifies weak regions from the previous model, applies targeted enhancement to those regions, and improves the reliability of supervision signals. sources.snippet: Info PaddleOCR provides a unified interface for the PaddleOCR-VL model series to facilitate quick setup and usage. Unless otherwise specified, the term "PaddleOCR-VL" in this tutorial and related hardware usage tutorials refers to the PaddleOCR-VL model series (e.g., PaddleOCR-VL-1.6). References specific to the PaddleOCR-VL v1 version will be explicitly noted.
